turns.question: Which day of the week had the highest average daily ad spend across all campaigns in September 2026, and what was that average in EUR?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for an average daily ad spend by weekday, and I do not compute averages myself; the closest metric is ad_spend_eur (total spend), which I could only total by weekday for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30: Wednesday is highest at 1,060 EUR (Tuesday 1,040, Thursday 860, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 830 each, Monday 820), but Tuesday and Wednesday occur five times in September and the other days four, so these totals are not averages and I cannot name the highest-average weekday. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
